title: Legal Metrology Compliance Checker
abstract: A critical review of the v1 specification and a replacement implementation plan. This document keeps what v1 got right — a deterministic, clause-citing rule engine and category-conditional logic — and rebuilds the parts that would not have survived contact with a real package, a real network, or a real enforcement officer. The three optimisation targets are stated up front and everything is designed against them: speed (a useful verdict on screen in under one second, without the network), accuracy (measured, not asserted — with precision on flags as the primary metric), and field usability (one-handed, sunlight-readable, works with no signal).
facts: SIH26034 — Automated compliance checking of pre-packaged commodity labels
Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 and amendments; with an optional extended pack for FSSAI / BIS / D&C statutes
Legal Metrology field enforcement officer (mobile, live scanning)
Controller / senior officer (web dashboard, e-commerce sweeps)
Proposed — sections marked LEGAL REVIEW require validation against the bare Act before demo
